faqs.q: What is the Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount is a low-speed, high-torque orbital hydraulic motor, listed in 84 part numbers with displacement 125 to 750 cm³/rev. Orbital motors suit machine drives that need torque at low shaft speed, and displacement sets the trade between speed and torque. The mounting is 6-bolt magneto.

faqs.q: How do I identify the part number of the Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount?
faqs.a: Quote the part number from the motor nameplate, which carries the model code. For example 500125A5102AAAAA (125 cm³/rev, 1.0" SAE 6B spline shaft, 6-bolt magneto mount, 7/8-14 O-ring ports) and 500750A5123ZAAAA (750 cm³/rev, 1 1/4" 14T spline shaft, 6-bolt magneto mount, 7/8-14 O-ring ports) are two of the 84 rows. The size table gives the displacement, shaft and port details for each part number.

faqs.q: What displacement range does the Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount cover?
faqs.a: The Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount spans 125 to 750 cm³/rev across 84 part numbers. That is 11 distinct displacements. A larger displacement turns slower with more torque for a given flow, and shaft speed in rpm is roughly flow in US gpm × 231 ÷ displacement in in³/rev, before volumetric losses.

faqs.q: Which shaft options does the Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount offer?
faqs.a: The shaft options on the Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount are 1 1/4" keyed, 1 1/4" 14T spline, 1" SAE 6B spline, 1" keyed and 4 more. Match the shaft to the machine, because keyed, spline and tapered shafts do not interchange. Give us the shaft type and diameter from your old motor, and the part number if you have it.

faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure or speed figures for the 84 part numbers of the Fluidyne 500 Series Orbital Motors, 6-Bolt Magneto Mount.
